title: 第17章 骑士团以命换命第18章 不能死我死给你看
slug: 御兽别人鉴定都是骗你开神兽

“呜~”
“砰！”
就在地狱犬即将咬上陈小草小腿的时候，只听一道破风声传来。
面前的地狱犬被直接撞飞了出去。
陈小草定睛一看。
竟然是一名见习骑士？
陈小草错愕抬眸，只见孤儿院大门的方向，刚刚离开的韩临正跪在地上，弓着身子，像是身上背负了什么无比沉重的东西。
而他的面前，三个身披由金色丝线勾勒而出的巨剑，上面串着一串深渊生物披风的人影，正单手掐着另外一个见习骑士的脖子，步履沉稳的走了进来。
这是。。。正式骑士！
陈小草瞳孔急速闪动。
看情况，这城主和见习骑士冲撞了骑士？
陈小草看到了生机！
“骑士大人，韩城城主与见习骑士勾结，想要强行占领我们孤儿院的土地。”
“这只地狱犬的主人，正是韩城城主韩临的弟弟韩川，他要在我没有登记入册之前击杀我！”
墨玉狐发挥不了作用，陈小草趁机将它收回御兽空间中疗伤。
被见习骑士砸翻的地狱犬已经翻起了身子，耷拉着耳朵爬伏在地上，它的旁边，是同样跪的板正的见习骑士。
陈小草看着三名骑士一步步走来，其他人完全不敢动弹的时候，也不管对方能不能听清，语速极快的将整个事件前因后果说了一遍。
等三名骑士走到她身前的时候，她刚好喊出了最后一句。
“请骑士大人为我做主！”

“踏~”
干脆的脚步声在陈小草身前落定。
她垂着头，看着出现在自己眼前的那双鳞甲锃亮的靴子，浑身上下止不住的颤抖。
“抬起头来。”
冷漠到极点的声音让陈小草一度以为是不是自己的系统苏醒了。
身体的反应比脑子还要快，陈小草下意识的抬起了头。
“啸月帝国公民陈小草，父母不详，出生地未知，于18年前被啸月帝国御兽师何念慈收养，并进行公民身份登记。”
“是你吗？”
陈小草点头。
“任务目标已确认。”
“任务开始执行。”
陈小草听的一头雾水。
什么任务？什么任务目标？
我吗？？？
“骑士大人，难道您不应该先惩治恶人吗？”
“他们。。。”
陈小草急切的话语被冰冷打断。
“证据。”

"Woo~"
"Bang!"
Just when the hell dog was about to bite Chen Xiaocao's calf, he heard the sound of breaking wind.
The Cerberus in front of him was directly knocked away.
Chen Xiaocao took a closer look.
Turns out to be a trainee knight?
Chen Xiaocao raised his eyes in shock and saw Han Lin, who had just left, kneeling on the ground in the direction of the orphanage gate, hunched over as if he was carrying something extremely heavy.
In front of him, three figures wearing giant swords outlined with golden threads and strung with a string of abyss creature cloaks were holding the neck of another trainee knight with one hand and walked in calmly.
This is. . . Official knight!
Chen Xiaocao's pupils flashed rapidly.
Judging from the situation, the city lord and the trainee knight collided with the knight?
Chen Xiaocao saw hope!
"Sir Knight, the Lord of Hancheng colluded with the trainee knights and wanted to forcibly occupy the land of our orphanage."
"The owner of this hell dog is Han Chuan, the younger brother of Han Lin, the lord of Han City. He wants to kill me before I am registered!"
The black jade fox was unable to play its role, so Chen Xiaocao took the opportunity to take it back to the beast control space for healing.
The Cerberus that had been knocked over by the trainee knight had already turned over and was lying on the ground with its ears drooped. Next to it was the upright trainee knight who was also kneeling.
Chen Xiaocao watched the three knights approaching step by step. When the others did not dare to move at all, he spoke very quickly and explained the entire incident, regardless of whether they could hear clearly.
When the three knights came to her, she just shouted the last sentence.
"Please, Lord Knight, make the decision for me!"
"Step~"
The sound of crisp footsteps settled in front of Chen Xiaocao.
She lowered her head and looked at the pair of boots with shiny scales that appeared in front of her eyes, her whole body trembling uncontrollably.
"Keep your head up."
The extremely cold voice made Chen Xiaocao think that his system had awakened.
The body's reaction was faster than the brain's, and Chen Xiaocao subconsciously raised his head.
"Chen Xiaocao, a citizen of the Xiaoyue Empire, whose parents are unknown and his place of birth is unknown, was adopted by He Nianci, the beast master of the Xiaoyue Empire, 18 years ago, and his citizenship was registered."
"Is it you?"
Chen Xiaocao nodded.
"Mission objective confirmed."
"The mission begins."
Chen Xiaocao was confused when he heard this.
What task? What mission objective?
Me? ? ?
"Lord Knight, shouldn't you punish the evildoers first?"
"They..."
Chen Xiaocao's urgent words were interrupted by Leng Bing.
"evidence."
